name: Anruoju
source:
This is an original boy's love game.
There's no rules to bound people in the city called "Anruoju."
It's a city full of madness, yet it seems like a paradise.
Maybe, it's not only this city that has gone crazy, but the world itself has...
Thus, people come to this city, looking for a paradise, knowing that it's just an illusion...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065229.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款原创的男孩爱情游戏。
在名为“安若居”的城市里，没有任何规则可以约束人们。
这是一座充满疯狂的城市，却又像是一座天堂。
或许，疯狂的不仅仅是这座城市，整个世界都……
于是，人们来到这座城市，寻找世外桃源，却知道这只是一个幻象……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065229.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
